title: dev-team fix-slices from add_fixes_from_text default to kind:code/mode:slice even when the fix is pure test-data/config content, causing repeated no-GREEN-commit rejections
details:
**What happened:** Across two repos in one dev-team run, every auto-queued fix-slice whose footprint was a JSON check-file or a documentation/config file (this project's `scripts/checks/*.json` test format, and a YAML comment) defaulted to `kind: code` / `mode: slice` (RED-then-GREEN). Since the fix's entire content is a "test-data" or comment-only change with no separate implementation file, `commit-red` had to be run with `--force` (the tool's `ASSERT_TOKENS`/`TEST_DECL` regex doesn't recognize this project's `expr`/`expect` JSON assertion format), and then `commit-green`/`integrate` always failed with "no implementation commit after RED" / "no-green-commit" since there was nothing left to commit. This happened 3 separate times in one run (engine repo F2, debug tool F1 and F4) and required me to hand-patch `.claude/dev-team/state.json`'s `kind`/`mode` fields (undocumented, against the skill's own "never edit state except plan.md" rule) to `docs`/`chore` + `work` before `next` would accept the already-correct, already-committed content.
**What the user said:** User didn't comment; observed by the model while orchestrating a dev-team run across two repos.
**Repro:** Have a reviewer/verification report emit a `fixes` block (via `add_fixes_from_text`) whose `files` are only JSON/YAML/doc files with no separate "implementation" file, and no `kind` specified in the fix spec. The engine defaults it to `code`, which is structurally unsatisfiable for a single-file test-data/comment fix.
**Evidence:** `~/.claude/skills/dev-team-v3.2/scripts/devteam.py`, `add_fixes_from_text` (around line 1594, `kind` defaulting) and the `mode == "slice"` no-green-commit check (~line 1417); reproduced in both `stable-be-infinity-strike-rampage` and `debugTool-infinity-strike-rampage/static` dev-team runs.
**Cause:** `add_fixes_from_text` only forces `kind` to `code` when a `chore/docs/perf` spec has no `verify` command (line ~1594); it never infers `kind: test` or `kind: docs` from the fix's own file list (e.g., all files matching `test_globs`, or all non-code extensions), so a reviewer-authored fix with a reasonable implicit kind still lands as the RED/GREEN default and needs manual state surgery to unblock.
